title: Never Off Your Mind

lyrics:
[Intro]
(Oh-oh, oh-oh)

[Verse 1]
Phone at three percent, my head is full of noise
Scrolling through a thousand lives, can't hear my own voice
Everybody's fake-smiling, filter on the pain
But You call me by my name like You knew me all along

[Pre-Chorus]
When I feel invisible
You see me, You see me

[Chorus]
I'm never off Your mind, never out of sight
Jesus, You're the light when I'm lost in the night
No likes, no views, still You chose me
I'm never off Your mind, You set me free
(Oh-oh, oh-oh)

[Verse 2]
Locker-room whispers saying I don't fit
Grades and expectations, sometimes I wanna quit
But You didn't wait for me to get it right
You ran into my mess and You turned on the light

[Pre-Chorus]
When I feel invisible
You see me, You see me

[Chorus]
I'm never off Your mind, never out of sight
Jesus, You're the light when I'm lost in the night
No likes, no views, still You chose me
I'm never off Your mind, You set me free

[Bridge]
(Rap-sung, rhythmic)
Not a follower count, I'm a follower now
Got grace on my feed and I'm saying it loud
Took the cross for me, that's love on repeat
Every heartbeat drops to the rhythm of "You're with me"

[Final Chorus]
(Key lift, full energy)
I'm never off Your mind, never out of sight
Jesus, You're the light when I'm lost in the night
No likes, no views, still You chose me
I'm never off Your mind, You set me free

[Outro]
(Oh-oh, oh-oh)
Never off Your mind
